notes.title: Azusa 1.2.3 Elite Reworks, Faster Travels, Bug Fixes and Gameplay Changes!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34184204/2b37e6783027a217195b9336862feb2cf16a78ac.png


About:
Hello guys, this week the updates of fixes 1.2.2 and 1.2.3 will come in a single update log, because the 1.2.2 had to deal with some important inner bug-fixes that wouldnt be worth an update log alone, these smaller versions of 1.2 will bring alot of bugfixes untill we can finally move ahead to the 1.3, buut we also brings some gameplay changes and some visual reworks in these version! If you want to help more the game constant updates, considere joining our patreons

Bugfixes:
 Fixed a bug where players could use ingame html to access other controls.
 Fixed a bug with the character creation menus.
 Another Attempt to fix a bug with machines.
 Fixed a bug with mouse drop at item boxes.
 Fixed a bug with /Pose roleplay command.
 Fixed some bugs related to the new trial trainings.
 Fixed some bugs related to horses.
 Fixed some bugs related with training mastery.
 Fixed some bugs with tailor and barber for patreons.
 Fixed some bugs with ignorantia armor.


Gameplay Changes:
 Bosses now have 3 MPs
 Each Elite armor now have an unique look, instead of simple color diffrence.
 Added run mode to use at travel window.
 Chat can now be accessed through travel window
 Run mode is based off speed status and flash dash
 Run mode costs alot of vigor
 Buffed the frequency of RP checks, happening now 2 times faster
 Decreased the minimal amount of RP score to reach the 2.5 base
 RP Checks now reward more activity over spams
 Added Knock Door commands to exteriors houses
 Added a new RP command, called /Dice, so people dont need to set macros to roll dices
 Values for /Dice are, /Dice D6, /Dice D20, /Dice D100
 New old male hair.
 When writing an event its now possible to set wich group of players will receive it.


Final Notes:
There are still more bugs to be fixed and some may not have been completelly fixed in this, these weeks I have been completelly focused in chasing these bugs, to finally prepare for the next round of actual new contents! Hope to see you all ingame!

notes.title: Azusa v1.1.1 Bugfixes, new animals and Full Screen mode!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34184204/a71cc972fd37ac8c92c4dd16df4733d545d7de63.png
About:
The first patch after steam release is here! And of course its focus would be bug fixes, I worked hard during this week trying to fix every reported bugs fast as possible. But also some minor design changes to make the game more friendly to new players, also according to suggestions;

Bugfixes:


 Fixed a bug with Battles regard to PVE fights restarting after the first attack.
 Fixed more spelling errors at Tips, and outdated information.
 Fixed a bug with crafting system, where it consumed an extra material.
 Fixed a bug at a walk able cliff at Heracles.
 Fixed a bug toward starting an active training right after finishing a rest could bug you.
 Fixed a bug with tree stumps
 Fixed a bug with Kappa skin colors going blue after creation
 Fixed a bug where people could see angel leaps effects, without having spiritual vision
 Fixed a text error regard to learning traits for classes always saying you needed 100 SP, when it actually varies from 100-300
 Fixed a bug where a removed skill "bakery" was still learn able, now breads are made through crafting system.
 Fixed a bug toward dropping decimal amounts of food.
 Fixed a bug where you could walk while shopping/crafting.
 Fixed some bugs toward farming.
 Fixed a typo with searching seeds skills
 Fixed a typo at masters training style skills
 Fixed some battle bugs toward the Monkey King skills
 Fixed a bug that happens when a NPC kills each other.
 Fixed a typo at Northern Nuts name
 Fixed a bug where spiritual beings real body turned visible when using Dream World.
 Fixed a bug where lethal mobs RPing with other NPCs.
 Fixed a bug with NPC shop's help button.
 Made a shield to a bug where players could randomly lose their name.
 Fixed a critical bug with the skill Thunder Wave.


Gameplay Changes:


 Increased Intelligence gains for Study Training Method.
 Reduced the required Intelligence to Self-Learn Recipes as a civilian.
 Nerfed small animals status by 50%.
 Changed Demon's Teleport return point in Underworld to the Hall of Judgments.
 Added a new small animal: Fox
 Added a new small animal: Rabbit /2 colors
 Added a new small animal: Raccoon /2 colors
 Added a new small animal: Squirrel /2 types
 Added a new small animal: Porcupine
 Some small animals now drops leather.
 Some small animals drop a vegetable.
 Reduced the early-game difficulty of the map: Asgard.
 Reduced the early-game difficulty of the map: Desert.
 Its now possible to create repeated Recipes with the Study Training Method.
 Added new custom architecture: Mill.
 Added a fullscreen mode. Press Esc to toggle it, or access through commands tab at the top of your screen!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34184204/338c45c94e5d14c0e4a5d184a519c6c62a0de323.jpg

In-game Roleplays

Will try to quickly mention the progression of the History of servers based at the screenshots uploaded in game. As its a great way to see how amazingly Azusa's history progresses naturally with its roleplays systems, allowing players really be part of the story.
In this featured scene, a group of Reapers were doing some bizarre rituals with demoniac creatures by the year 318.
Prophecies said that Hades vessel would be predicted by the return of Reapers walking on earth.
Meanwhile, a lot of things are happening around the world of Azusa! Physical and spiritually! Demons fighting Angels, The Grand Master of Heracles ordering the murder of a baby... A lot of mystery adventures starting, and some ending as lost wanderers dies in Deep Forests!

Final Notes:

If you want to know more about any topic, feel free to ask questions in commentary and I will explain them better! Thanks for reading till here, and hope to see you all in game!
If you want to know more about Azusa's Roleplay Systems read our Guides before playing, as this game tries to deliver something completelly different comparing to a normal mmorpg!

Also, visit our website! And view previous update logs!

notes.title: Azusa v1.1.0 and Release Date revealed!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34184204/bfb1ac0ad8646f8a7b62efbac0cbd8bb794c1d56.png


Release date:

Azusa will release in January 30th, the servers will be open during this period of five days for Admins only, they will finish setting the in game final details, like trials, ranks and more. Keep up to date with us in our discord channels!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34184204/833f726b67238dbb4bece2bda84a98f9890d66ac.png

Azusa v1.1.0

Gameplay Changes:

 If you obtain a funder clothes, you can now equip them.
 Added a new trial finish setting that sends the player to another coord.
 Changed the building doors displacement
 Added a new trial key type that disappears when used.
 Added a new trial key req type, that checks the players maximum age, (used for babies trial keys)
 Added new Angel and Demon Skill: Spiritual Protections.
 Treasure Boxes in map now opens with password, to be used with trial keys.
 Review at Ban Warning texts.
 Removed Admin Verbs related to tournament doors. (to avoid bugs)
 Review in tips.
 Review in Grab Skill.
 Nerf in Telekinetic Lemurian's blast.


Bugfixes:

 Fixed a bug with BSG volume settings
 Fixed a bug with right clicking players showing a wrong tab
 Fixed a bug with selling equipped items to shops
 Fixed a bug related with gold minerals and money.
 Fixed a bug where it was possible to build a house for free.
 Fixed a bug related to NPC tournaments fights.
 Fixed a bug related to Roasted meat display names.
 Fixed a bug with Search Seed display message.
 Fixed a layering bugs in Third Jail of hell.
 Fixed a bug related to negative health at PVE.
 Fixed a bug at training arrows disappearing.
 Fixed a bug with Acheron river.
 Fixed text error at Spend Skill Points.
 Fixed text error at portuguese tips.
 Fixed text error at status descriptions.



If you want to know more about any topic, feel free to ask questions in commentary and I will explain them better! Thanks for reading till here, and hope to see you all in game after the release!
Also, help us to talk about Azusa to your friends! You can check out some useful guides in our website! And also view previous update logs!
